sources.meaning: The implementation constructs T cross V and applies the signed scalar offset in that direction.

The class contract states T cross V, while the constructor prose says V cross T; the evaluator implementation above resolves the actual sign. The constructor declaration takes basis curve, signed distance, reference direction, and optional isNotCheckC0.
